title: Compare both builds against the proposed relevance rule
description:
PR #3 proposal (spec 1.1 / contract 1.2). Local: 9 synthetic cases passed with 3 admission differences. The proposal excludes a broad two-topic item and an author-only AGI match. Its literal substring rule admits “magic” via “AGI”, and both policies admit the ambiguous phrase “wheel alignment”. The current feed policy remains active. Both partners still need to agree on phrase boundaries and run the blind live relevance review. Both deployed builds still need verification.

Freeze the proposed phrase table for both builds. Match a listed phrase in the title or summary regardless of case; reject a weak mention or a generic two-tag item when neither contains a listed phrase. Test a mixed-case phrase and a summary-only phrase. Record where the current ontology rule differs; keep feed quality and the blind relevance score separate from phrase parity.
